## Overview
Recommendation Filtering

## User Story
As a DevOps engineer, I want to filter recommendations so that I can focus on specific types of improvements

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Implement filter bar component
- [ ] Support filtering by category/tags
- [ ] Allow filtering by difficulty level
- [ ] Enable filtering by estimated time savings
- [ ] Persist filter selections

- **Priority:** P2
- **Story Points:** 5

## User Stories

### Create Filter Bar Component
- **Story:** As a DevOps engineer, I want to see a filter bar above my recommendations so that I can access filtering options in one place
- **Priority:** P2
- **Story Points:** 3
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] Filter bar component renders above recommendation list
  - [ ] Filter bar contains sections for categories, difficulty, and time savings
  - [ ] Filter bar maintains consistent styling with app theme
  - [ ] Component is responsive across different screen sizes

### Implement Category Filtering
- **Story:** As a DevOps engineer, I want to filter recommendations by category so that I can focus on specific areas of improvement
- **Priority:** P2
- **Story Points:** 5
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] Category filter dropdown shows all available categories
  - [ ] Multiple categories can be selected
  - [ ] Selected categories are visually indicated
  - [ ] Recommendation list updates immediately when categories are selected/deselected
  - [ ] API endpoint returns filtered results based on selected categories

### Implement Difficulty Level Filtering
- **Story:** As a DevOps engineer, I want to filter by difficulty level so that I can find recommendations matching my expertise
- **Priority:** P2
- **Story Points:** 3
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] Difficulty level filter shows all available levels
  - [ ] Multiple difficulty levels can be selected
  - [ ] Selected levels are visually indicated
  - [ ] Recommendation list updates based on selected difficulty levels
  - [ ] Filtering works in combination with other filters

### Implement Time Savings Filter
- **Story:** As a DevOps engineer, I want to filter by estimated time savings so that I can prioritize high-impact recommendations
- **Priority:** P2
- **Story Points:** 3
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] Time savings filter includes a range slider
  - [ ] Slider shows min/max values from available recommendations
  - [ ] Selected range is clearly displayed
  - [ ] Recommendation list updates as range is adjusted
  - [ ] Filtering works in combination with other filters

### Create Filter State Management Service
- **Story:** As a DevOps engineer, I want my filter selections to persist so that I don't have to reapply them each time
- **Priority:** P2
- **Story Points:** 5
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] Filter selections are saved to local storage
  - [ ] Filter selections are restored when returning to recommendations
  - [ ] Filter state is managed centrally through FilterStore service
  - [ ] Changes to filters are reflected in URL parameters
  - [ ] Filter preferences are synced with backend


## Non-Functional Requirements
- Performance: API response times < 200ms
- Security: Follow OWASP Top 10 guidelines
- Scalability: Support horizontal scaling
